text: {"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strncasecmp() in lib/string.c advanced s1 backwards with `*s1--` instead of forwards with `*s1++`, so I changed it to `*s1++`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strcspn() looped with `--p` instead of `++p`, so it walked backwards. I changed it to `++p`. I couldn't build or run the tests here, so the fix is unverified; the reported failure is in string_test_strspn and I did not read that test, so I'm inferring it exercises strcspn."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_get_size(), the loop that reduces `size` below 32 bits decremented the unit index (`i--`) instead of incrementing it (`i++`), so large sizes mapped to the wrong unit (\"UNK\"); I changed it back to `i++`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_escape_mem(), the source pointer was decremented (`*src--`) instead of incremented (`*src++`), so it read the input backwards. I changed it to `*src++`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_unescape(), the escape check tested `src[1] == '\\0'` instead of `src[1] != '\\0'`, so backslash escapes were never processed. I flipped it to `!=`. I haven't built or run the tests."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_option(), a leading '-' was handled with `--cur` instead of `++cur`, so the parser re-read the byte before the minus sign instead of skipping past it; I changed it to `++cur`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_options(), the loop-exit check was inverted (`res != 1` instead of `res == 1`), so parsing stopped after the first comma or range. I restored `res == 1`."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "Fixed memparse() where the 'G' case used `ret << 10;` (no effect) instead of `ret <<= 10;`, which broke parsing of G-suffixed sizes such as mem=1G."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "In __siphash_aligned the tail-length mask was `len & (sizeof(u64) - 2)` instead of `- 1`, which dropped tail bytes for odd lengths; I restored it to `- 1`. I couldn't build or run the tests here, so the fix is untested."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "Fixed the tail-length mask in the 64-bit __hsiphash_aligned from `len & (sizeof(u64) - 2)` to `len & (sizeof(u64) - 1)`, so odd tail lengths are no longer dropped."}
